1.scene: The riverside cinder track curves past silver reeds in fresh morning sunshine; she lifts an open water bottle after completing her run.
1.outfit: A teal cropped racerback running top and coral mini running shorts with silver side piping reveal her midriff, shoulders and legs; white running shoes.

reasons.scene: The running recovery example leaves the track and weather open; silver reeds establish a riverside route and morning sun.

reasons.axes: Her turn after the run motivates mostly active; teal and silver keep balanced source echoes; the crop top and shorts require separates.

2.scene: An amber-tiled open-air bath courtyard borders shallow rippling water; a brief fountain splash breaks the late-afternoon reflections along the path.
2.outfit: An opaque ivory strapless one-piece swimsuit with an indigo heritage textile pattern, matching narrow trim and a deep structured neckline reveals shoulders and collarbones.

reasons.scene: The swimsuit example supplies neither a location nor weather; the amber courtyard and fountain splash establish a water setting for the planned surprised recovery step.

reasons.axes: A quick light jogging movement along the wet path is mostly active; indigo stays a subtle source color; the single swimsuit uses balanced separates.

3.scene: Her closed cream umbrella drips onto a ceramic tray beside the entryway as evening rain streaks the glass; she carries the loosened raincoat away from her shoulders.
3.outfit: A rust-orange cropped knit top with ivory mini shorts reveals her waist and thighs beneath the open, slipping raincoat; low black rain boots.

reasons.scene: The example specifies entryway and slipping off a raincoat but leaves props and time open; a wet umbrella and dark evening glass make the return from rain readable.

reasons.axes: Walking in while releasing a wet coat is mostly active; blue-gray rainwear offers balanced source color while rust changes the silhouette; knit and shorts use prefer separates.
